Cascader

Cascader presents a hierarchical selection interface where choosing a parent option reveals its children in adjacent panels. Ideal for navigation menus, location pickers, and category selection.

Basic Cascader

Click to open panels, navigate through hierarchy levels.

HTML
<div class="zak-cascader" style="position: relative;">
  <input type="text" class="zak-input" placeholder="Select location..." readonly style="cursor: pointer;">
  <div class="zak-cascader-panel" style="position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: row;"></div>
</div>

Hover Trigger

Open sub-panels on hover instead of click.

Default Value

Pre-select a value on initialization.

Disabled Options

Some options can be disabled and cannot be selected.

Demo JavaScript

JavaScript
var locations = [
  { label: 'USA', value: 'usa', children: [
    { label: 'California', value: 'ca', children: [
      { label: 'Los Angeles', value: 'la' },
      { label: 'San Francisco', value: 'sf' }
    ]},
    { label: 'New York', value: 'ny', children: [
      { label: 'New York City', value: 'nyc' },
      { label: 'Buffalo', value: 'buf' }
    ]}
  ]},
  { label: 'China', value: 'china', children: [
    { label: 'Sichuan', value: 'sc', children: [
      { label: 'Chengdu', value: 'cd' },
      { label: 'Mianyang', value: 'my' }
    ]},
    { label: 'Beijing', value: 'bj', children: [
      { label: 'Dongcheng', value: 'dc' }
    ]}
  ]}
];

var categories = [
  { label: 'Electronics', value: 'electronics', children: [
    { label: 'Computers', value: 'computers', children: [
      { label: 'Laptops', value: 'laptops' },
      { label: 'Desktops', value: 'desktops', disabled: true }
    ]},
    { label: 'Phones', value: 'phones' }
  ]},
  { label: 'Clothing', value: 'clothing', disabled: true, children: [
    { label: 'Men', value: 'men' },
    { label: 'Women', value: 'women' }
  ]}
];

function initCascader(id, data, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  var container = document.getElementById(id);
  var input = container.querySelector('input');
  var panel = container.querySelector('.zak-cascader-panel');
  var path = [];

  function renderPanel(items, level) {
    var col = document.createElement('div');
    col.style.cssText = 'min-width: 160px; max-height: 200px; overflow-y: auto; border-right: 1px solid var(--zak-border); padding: 0.25rem 0;';
    items.forEach(function (item) {
      var el = document.createElement('div');
      var hasChildren = item.children && item.children.length;
      el.style.cssText = 'padding: 0.5rem 1rem; cursor: ' + (item.disabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer') + '; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 0.875rem;' + (item.disabled ? ' opacity: 0.5;' : '') + (path[level] === item.label ? ' background: var(--zak-bg-hover);' : '');
      el.textContent = item.label;
      if (hasChildren) {
        var arrow = document.createElement('span');
        arrow.style.cssText = 'color: var(--zak-text-muted); font-size: 0.75rem;';
        arrow.textContent = '›';
        el.appendChild(arrow);
      }
      if (item.disabled) {
        el.style.color = 'var(--zak-text-muted)';
      }
      col.appendChild(el);
      if (!item.disabled) {
        (opts.trigger === 'hover' ? el.addEventListener('mouseover', handleItem) : el.addEventListener('click', handleItem));
      }
      function handleItem() {
        path = path.slice(0, level);
        path[level] = item.label;
        while (panel.children.length > level + 1) panel.removeChild(panel.lastChild);
        if (hasChildren) renderPanel(item.children, level + 1);
        else { input.value = path.join(' / '); panel.style.display = 'none'; }
      }
    });
    panel.appendChild(col);
  }

  input.addEventListener('click', function () {
    panel.style.display = panel.style.display === 'none' ? 'flex' : 'none';
    if (panel.style.display === 'flex') { panel.innerHTML = ''; renderPanel(data, 0); }
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('#' + id)) panel.style.display = 'none'; });
}

initCascader('cascader-basic', locations);
initCascader('cascader-hover', locations, { trigger: 'hover' });
initCascader('cascader-default', locations);
initCascader('cascader-disabled', categories);
